author: Mark Atwood
text: INDEPENDENT VERIFICATION of the landed main state (beads-worker-2, 2026-09-09). Note: this worker duplicated the bead against a STALE checkout (pre-5c9f7ef657 main) and reproduced the polarity-bug class on its own attempt before discovering worker8's landing via merge; recording for the audit trail. (1) Algorithm: main's ygg_addr_from_pubkey mirrors upstream address.go faithfully (explicit bit-invert then count-leading-ones with wrapping u8, skip + first-0, MSB-first whole-byte pack, min(14) tail copy, degenerate all-ones-inverted key falls through with empty packed tail). Cross-checked against a literal standalone port AND a live yggdrasil-go harness (go1.26.5, module replace to upstream @HEAD): anchor bdbacfd8..6efb -> 0200848a604fbb7e438465db8db66895 / subnet 0300848a604fbb7e byte-exact on both; edge keys 00/ff/ab/01 all match Go. (2) Test state on merged beads-worker-2 (== main for rust/): cargo test -p lichen-core -p lichen-node -p lichen-gateway = 27/28 binaries green; sole failures = the 8 end_to_end tests already owned by a763. (3) Additional uncovered invariant sites filed as ywec (router.rs:711 test-identity lookup, node.rs:387/748, secure.rs:1933, rpl_stack/secure.rs:143, gradient.rs:178/318, announce.rs destinations). (4) Duplicate local impl variants preserved on branch wip/i72x2-upstream-addr-impl (local only); beads-worker-2 merged to main content (merge commits a6a04f9ad7, bdafea1654) and the merge had duplicated-content resolution errors in constants.rs/l2_payload.rs/shared_vectors.rs/receive.rs that were repaired by restoring main's versions — SOS dispatch code confirmed intact after repair.
